From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Corp HR <hr@acme.com>, TalentOps Solutions <talentops@vendor.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proactive HC tradeoff and performance alignment plan

Team —

TL;DR: I recommend we request a targeted freeze exception for one IC backfill on Team Atlas (IC-4 backend) and instead reallocate a 0.5 FTE from Team Beacon for Q3 while we complete the performance improvement plan (PIP) and post-review. Rationale: preserves delivery for the upcoming model optimization milestone, limits incremental headcount, and buys time to evaluate the review outcomes.

Key facts:
- Role: Backend engineer (IC-4) on Team Atlas; vacancy created 2027-07-30 after voluntary departure.
- Immediate risk: two-month delay to the model-serving latency improvements if left unfilled.
- Proposed tradeoff: 0.5 FTE temporary redeployment from Team Beacon (senior engineer rotation) + contractor cover ~20 hours/week to handle priority bug backlog.

Asks:
1) Laura — approval to submit a "freeze exception" to People Ops with the attached one-page justification (attached: HC_Playbook_v2.pdf, freeze-exception-request.docx).
2) Marissa — can you attach the latest performance-summary for the adjacent role and confirm whether the PIP window overlaps Q3 deliverables (attached: perf-summary.csv)?
3) Evelyn — if we get a provisional exception, please advise on billing/chargeback implications for the reserve budget.

I want to keep this lightweight: a 72-hour decision window would be ideal so we can post the contractor request and schedule the redeployment. If anyone strongly objects to the 0.5 FTE compromise, please reply with alternative mitigation by EOD Monday.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Director, Infrastructure Products
Redwood Inference

Attachments: HC_Playbook_v2.pdf (summary), org_chart_v3.png (team map), freeze-exception-request.docx (draft)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Proactive HC tradeoff and performance alignment plan

Jonas — thanks for the clear framing. A few quick notes:

- I support the principle of a temporary 0.5 FTE redeploy if it does not create an operational hole on Beacon. Please confirm the exact individual(s) proposed.
- We need a short risk matrix for exec review: customer impact, timeline slide, and a fallback if contractor sourcing takes longer than 2 weeks.
- People Ops will likely push back on contractors for >12 weeks without an approved JD; mention the contractor hours as a short-term stopgap in the request.

On the PIP overlap: prima facie acceptable, but I need Marissa's perf summary before I sign off on the exception.

On quoting your note: "If anyone strongly objects..., please reply" — I'll flag this to Growth Eng for a quick check-in so we don't create a cross-team dependency.

-Laura

Folks — attaching the perf-summary.csv as requested. High level:
- The adjacent IC on Atlas has shown regressed throughput on a single metric (cache hit ratio); manager-led PIP started 2027-07-15 with documented checkpoints.
- Immediate contribution to the Q3 milestone is limited to infra-stage tasks; the PIP window runs through 2027-09-01.

Given the window, a 0.5 FTE redeploy from Beacon (we propose N. Patel for the first 6 weeks) plus a contractor at ~20 hrs/wk should keep milestone exposure low. If the PIP shows steady progress at the mid-point (Aug 28), we convert the stopgap into a permanent backfill search; otherwise we open a full req.

Contractor sourcing update: TalentOps can surface vetted candidates within 7 business days; budget estimate attached to the shared Drive link.

Proposed language for the freeze-exception request (paste-ready):
"Request: Targeted freeze exception to temporarily redeploy 0.5 FTE from Team Beacon and engage a short-term contractor (max 12 weeks) to maintain Q3 deliverables for Team Atlas. Rationale: mitigates delivery risk while preserving headcount discipline pending review outcomes."

If that looks good I can finalize the doc and loop People Ops for formal sign-off.

—Marissa
Senior Manager, Program Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: perf-summary.csv

Please find a consolidated request for a targeted freeze exception attached (freeze-exception-request.docx) and the proposed exec-friendly rationale below. Requesting an expedited review (48–72 hours) because the contractor posting needs to go live to meet our Q3 milestone.

Exec rationale (one paragraph):
Targeted exception to temporarily redeploy 0.5 FTE from Team Beacon and engage a short-term contractor (<=12 weeks) to keep Team Atlas on track for the August/September model-serving performance milestone. This avoids an immediate headcount increase while preserving delivery for a critical customer commitment (Acme Corp pilot).
